notes.title: Antonblast Release
notes.content:
[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/42990367/9d3568d4c479ef6da9104f71bc4279613e228cb4.png[/img]

The wait is finally over. After a very successful Kickstarter in 2022 and 100,000 wishlists later, Antonblast has been released!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1887400/ANTONBLAST/

[b]ANTONBLAST [/b]is a fast-paced explosive action platformer that's all about destruction. Play as the enraged [b]Dynamite Anton[/b] (or his cranked-out coworker [b]Annie[/b]) and use your [b]Mighty F’n Hammer[/b] to demolish bizarre worlds, tussle with screen-filling bosses, and steal your [b]Spirits [/b]back from [b]Satan[/b]!

That's right: Satan himself has stolen Anton's prized Spirit collection, and he'll stop at nothing to get it back. Thankfully, the local disgraced casino owner, Brulo, has his own beef with Satan, and he's willing to put aside his differences with Anton to make that devil pay.

Your mission in every level is simple: [b]SET [/b]Brulo's Detonators, [b]FIND [/b]Anton's Spirit, and [b]ESCAPE [/b]before Happy Hour ends!
[list]
[*]     [b]BLAST [/b]through a unique powertrip of a platformer!
[*]     [b]INDULGE [/b]in an urban graffiti-inspired art style!
[*]     [b]DEMOLISH [/b]massive destructible environments!
[*]     [b]BATTLE [/b]brutal, earthshaking bosses!
[*]     [b]EXPERIMENT [/b]with a totally dynamic playstyle; rush through for the best time or explore at your own pace!
[/list]


[h1]FEATURES[/h1]

[list]
[*]     [b]Shock and Awe![/b] Unlike other platforming heroes, Anton's not content to stay in his lane. Jet between the foreground and background layers for 2.5d platforming action!
[*]     [b]Destructible Everything![/b] Use Anton's mighty hammer to break down your environments!
[*]    [b] Hurry Up! It's Happy Hour![/b] Once Anton gets to the end of a level, set off the Spirit Detonator and dash back to the start before everything blows!
[*]     12 unique sprawling worlds with tons to explore!
[*]     Dynamic play style - rush to the end or explore at your own pace!
[*]     Silky smooth platforming gameplay with best-in-class controls!
[*]     Breathtaking hand-drawn animation!
[*]     Brutal earthshaking bosses!
[*]     A groovy, retro-flavored dynamic soundtrack!
[*]     Loads of replay value: Hard Mode, Boss Rush, and more!
[/list]
https://youtu.be/IYqE7h1YNUA?si=Y1q6RAqWK7fWW_Fb

notes.title: Into the HIVE! - Hotfix #3
notes.content:
Hey, you beautiful cluckers!
The third hotfix pack is here with some eggcelent goodies:

[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where the wrong character spoke in the wrong voice in a specific dialogue.
[*] Fixed several typos, we will continue to do this (a long script, you know...)
[*] Fixed a bug in the Glass Shard minigame
[*] We also fixed and tweaked the collider of collectibles, so they are a bit easier to pick up (especially with a controller)
[*] Made several small graphical polishes
[*] Slightly changed the opening text of the credits because unfortunately, some people misunderstood it (in a quite negative way). Now our message is the same, but more simple and clear.
[*] And we made some system-wide code fixes for a much smoother and more fluid gameplay experience. (too boring to list)
[/list]

Thank you for playing and loving our game! 
Have fun, and continue to be awesome!

We will come back with more fixes and enhancements soon!
[i]Be safe, and play more!
The Wild Gentlemen[/i]

notes.title: Steam Next Fest is officially here, which means it's time to dig into our demo!
notes.content:
[h2]Dear Detectives,[/h2]

Steam Next Fest is upon us once more, beckoning with promises of intrigue and mystery. [b]Behold, the hour has struck sample the mysterious depths of Chicken Police: Into the HIVE! this week.[/b] The demo offers an exclusive glimpse into the narrative set to unfold later this year. Traverse carefully curated snippets and scenes from the game's starting chapter, a sneak peek into the grand adventure awaiting within the full release of the game.

But the rendezvous does not end there, dear detective. Your insights are needed, and your impressions are sought after. Share your thoughts and give your feedback on our [url=https://discord.gg/wSX5QUEmku]Discord [/url]and [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2362090/discussions/0/4211497459235029031/]Steam[/url] forums. Your voice is the key to unlocking the full potential of Chicken Police: Into the HIVE!

[previewyoutube=MjTIFaP7JnQ;full][/previewyoutube]
[h2]What content can you find in the demo?[/h2]

Prepare to plunge into the murky streets of Clawville. This time, Sonny Featherland and Marty MacChicken venture into the grim outskirts, a notorious domain known as the Hive. Infested with bugs and teeming with crime.

A chilling, calculated murder happened in the Hive's dark alleys, and Sonny is asked to unravel its sinister threads. Unlike the orderly facade of Clawville, the folks in the Hive scoff at the rule of law. Sonny and Marty may find their badges powerless amidst the chaos. Will they be chicken enough to succeed, or will it all turn out to be a big cluck-up?

[b]Features:[/b]
[list]
[*] 11 fully voiced characters!
[*] 1-2 hours of gameplay
[*] 7 locations
[*] 4 cutscenes
[*] 2 minigames
[*] Noir and color modes
[*] Unlimited amount of animal puns
[/list][h2]Join our eggsclusive Dev Streams![/h2]

The revelry doesn't cease with just the demo. [b]Throughout this week, the Wild Gentlemen extend an invitation to not one, but TWO live streams right here on Steam.[/b]  Bálint Bánk Varga and Adri [i](respectively the creative director of the Chicken Police series and the community manager of the Wild Gentlemen)[/i] will navigate the demo's twists and turns, shedding light on their craft with insightful commentary. During these streams, you will have the chance to interrogate the minds behind the game. The Streams go live at the following times:

[h3][url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2362090/view/3962671841223313515?l=english]8pm CET/2pm EST sharp on the 7th of February [/url]
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2362090/view/3962671841223315702?l=english]9pm CET/3PM EST sharp on the 8th of February [/url][/h3]

[h2]The Chickenhunt is coming to an end![/h2]

[b]As Steam Next Fest takes center stage, [url=https://www.reddit.com/r/Chickenpolicegame/comments/1ajjlyo/chicken_police_chickenhunt_final_part_8_submit/]the last chapter of Sonny's Chickenhunt unfolds on Reddit[/url]. [/b]Now's your moment, pal. Lock eyes with that riddle, decipher its enigmatic code, and shoot us your final answer. [b]The prize? A shot at snagging some exclusive Chicken Police merch delivered right to your door.[/b] So be sure to check it out!

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44280905/0e2f25fbac9aba1def6b05789e9ccb3bb133c60a.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44280905/0e2f25fbac9aba1def6b05789e9ccb3bb133c60a.jpg[/img][/url]

No need to sweat if you've been laying low, avoiding the hunt. [b]The winners will be plucked from the pool of those who crack the code and send the correct answer before the end of Steam Next Fest. [/b]

notes.title: CHICKENS OF GAMESCOM AND PAX - Devblog Extra
notes.content:
Hey friends!

With Gamescom and PAX West happening almost back-to-back, saying we've had a busy couple of weeks would be an understatement. However, these weeks were also very exciting and inspiring! These two events were the very first opportunity for us to share the Chicken Police – Into the HIVE! with the public and get your honest feedback in person. So, let's talk about what happened.

[h2]GAMESCOM 2023[/h2]

The three founders of The Wild Gentlemen, Tamás, Péter and Bánk, flew to the beautiful Cologne, Germany to visit Gamescom! We were thrilled to be back with a new game, after we presented Chicken Police – Paint it RED! to the public in 2019. 

Gamescom was shaping up to be very hot this year, but we were super excited – and anxious – to allow the public to play the Chicken Police – Into the HIVE! demo for the very first time. It would be the first opportunity for us to get feedback, so we didn't quite know what to expect quite yet.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44280905/11e70fba35e991cee49531466cd7094eefcd1bed.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44280905/c23157a0d5238ea7d922b664616a85e005efb0bd.jpg[/img]

With a new game comes a new booth. While we designed the booth ourselves, we hired an outside contractor to do the building for us. This means we didn't know exactly what the booth would end up looking like when we arrived at Gamescom. Any worries were completely unwarranted however, as we were completely amazed by how the booth turned out! It looked wonderful and very eye-catching amongst the other stands. It was sure to catch people's attention, so we had to make some preparations. We're glad we did!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44280905/164ad5016465b4f2ac7a325e9711587f3269ddc0.jpg[/img]

We had four computers in our stand, all loaded up with the demo for Chicken Police – Into the HIVE! We had to fix an unexpected glitch on the spot, but we got this done before the first visitors arrived. And arrive you did! It was very busy at the booth at all times; we were overwhelmed by everyone who stopped by. A lot of you took the time to play the demo as well, and to our surprise, most of you played through the whole thing. Mind you, this demo was 30 to 45 minutes long! That's a long sit for an expo demo when there are so many amazing games to try on Gamescom.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44280905/331f9babe36174f7081eca5154f7d274fc02b8e0.jpg[/img]

We simply couldn't believe the amount of positive buzz we got from everyone who played the demo! Aside from one thing we were already working on, and another things that was still on the list, there were no negative remarks about the demo. Everyone who played was just sucked in and loved every minute of it. This feedback is also very useful to us! We introduced some brand new features to Chicken Police – Into the HIVE and we weren't sure how well they would be received. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44280905/f2b932464452c5152e535b930e12c5b0d5735328.jpg[/img]

One of these features was the Technicolor mode, which we announced and showed in the Chicken Police – Into the HIVE! Gameplay Reveal Trailer. This mode allows you to experience Clawville like never before in full-color vision. This feature is an optional toggle for those who feel noir is a bit too... noir.

Most of you tried the Technicolor mode and told us you loved the look of it. That didn't stop the majority from switching back to Noir mode however, which is why the mode is optional. Noir is and will always be the default mode of the game. Though, even those who switched back to noir mode let us know that they enjoyed seeing the many faces of- and locations in Clawville in their colorful selves. It was one if the most dramatic features we added, and we weren't sure how people would react to it. It was a huge relief to hear all the praise. Thank you!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44280905/b8645be88c78007ce298170dcf3c7dcb4460f320.jpg[/img]

While standing and talking 8-10 hours a day definitely takes a toll on your body, our souls were full of energy and inspiration after talking to all of you. We couldn't wait to get back home and return to development of Chicken Police – Into the HIVE!, because we knew we were on the right track.

Gamescom was fantastic because of you. A huge thank you to everyone who stopped by and played the demo!

[h2]PAX WEST 2023[/h2]

Then there's PAX West in Seattle. PAX West was everything we loved about Gamescom, but cranked up to eleven. Tamás Sinka was there to represent us alongside our publisher, Joystick Ventures. Tamás reported the same kind amount of love and praise for the game as we got on Gamescom. All the universal love across the globe really is overwhelming and inspiring! We heard a lot of "What the hell is this?" and similar reactions when they read "Chicken Police" or saw the booth design. These reactions of disbelief will always be our favorites.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44280905/d2a8ff9a2bb482c29433b4742c43d5b3cec2a047.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44280905/82bf3b0f8f1661937f57f7e836c5e6feecdcd6d4.jpg[/img]

Tamás came back from PAX West tired as hell, but full of great stories and a revitalized spirit. Much like Gamescom, there were even people who came to the event just for us! Considering we're still just a small team developing such a weird game, this means a lot to us and we can't thank you enough.

[h2]SO... WHAT'S NEXT?[/h2]

With all the kind words still bouncing around our skulls, we will now focus on expanding and polishing this version to perfection. Soon you'll be able to experience everything we worked so hard on in the first public demo, which you'll be able to give a go from the comfort of your own home. Saves you a flight to Cologne or Seattle!

In the meantime, be sure to check out the Chicken Police – Into the HIVE! Gameplay Trailer if you haven't already! Remember to wishlist the game and follow us on our socials. It all helps us out a ton and allows you to stay up to date with all the news on this game.

Again, thank you so much for everything.

- [i]The Wild Gentlemen[/i]

notes.title: Chicken Police – Into the HIVE! | Gameplay Reveal Trailer
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=lCGPFs1mL9o;full][/previewyoutube]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2362090/Chicken_Police_Into_the_HIVE/

The detective duo of Sonny and Marty, the legendary Chicken Police, get wound up in a big conspiracy that will put Clawville truly on the brink of collapse. This particular case will have them venture into one of the less pleasant areas of the city: The Hive.

Chicken Police – Into the HIVE! features new stories, locations, characters, and mysteries to be solved. All are supported by improved visuals and a cast featuring a lot of familiar faces and even more new ones. If you enjoyed Chicken Police – Paint it RED!, we're sure you'll love this as well. However, you don't need to have played the previous game to understand and enjoy Chicken Police – Into the HIVE!.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44280905/8ccad9b0b22caeef4123dd529df747625f60f669.jpg[/img]

[h2]Technicolor Mode[/h2]

Yes, you read that right, partner. Experience Clawville like never before in the all-new Technicolor mode! With just a quick flip of the switch, you'll be able to crack cases - and appreciate Monica - in full color. 

If this takes the [i]noir[/i] out of the [i]noir[/i] detective game for you, don't worry! You can just as easily swap back to the default depressed noir mode you already know and love. There's no downside to choosing either!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44280905/54c68b98a2e124433b1fb69b52aef8381f522dde.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44280905/1f92db8ccca5dc853b01a11fc11e63e1d7169817.jpg[/img]

Cluckin' excited? So are we! Be sure to wishlist Chicken Police – Into the HIVE! while you're here. It would really help us out with getting it out in the world and allows you to stay up to date with the latest news and insights into the game.
